items.headline: Using mathematics to validate network configurations
items.excerpt: Static analysis of deployed networks helps reduce the risk that sensitive data leaks across partitions, supporting the security and reliability of global-scale networking.

items.headline: Mitra-v2: Scaling synthetic pretraining for tabular foundation models
items.excerpt: Expanding the mix of synthetic data used to train a tabular foundation model enables it to adapt to new tables without new models and lead the single-model field on the TabArena benchmark.
